title: [TASK] Shelf actions and the overdue banner
body:
## What to build

Shelf owners archive shelves from the Shelves page, and the page warns about overdue loans.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each active shelf on the Shelves page shows an Archive button to a member who may archive it
- [ ] Archiving a shelf removes it from the number in the Shelves page title
- [ ] When a loan is more than 14 days overdue, the Shelves page shows a banner with the number of overdue loans
